papers.title: ETA
papers.local_path: paper/Agent系列latex论文/Agent动作投机/ETA- Exit on Tool Arrival in Speculative Agent Loops/102_ETA_Exit_on_Tool_Arrival_i.pdf
papers.mechanism: SPORK + stable full-call agreement + unconstrained tool probability + tool-ready early reasoning exit.
papers.decision: Direct baseline for reducing reasoning; changes the Actor policy, with empirical quality validation rather than exact original-output equivalence.

papers.title: SpecAgent
papers.local_path: paper/Agent系列latex论文/Agent动作投机/Trajectory-Level Speculation with Semantic Verification for Tool-Using Agents/main.tex
papers.mechanism: Weak-model read-only trajectories; strong semantic prefix review and fused repair before state-changing boundaries.
papers.decision: Alternative baseline for reducing strong-model generation; semantic acceptance changes policy. All-read chunks at the depth cap need not receive strong review.

papers.title: ObsSpec
papers.local_path: paper/Agent系列latex论文/Agent动作投机/ObsSpec- Accelerating Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Observation Speculation/main.tex
papers.mechanism: Predict observations, overlap subsequent Actor computation, validate observations before commit; learn world model during RL.
papers.decision: Defer on current short hidden tools; reconsider for long real tool waits and RL throughput.

papers.title: DLite
papers.local_path: paper/Agent系列latex论文/Agent动作投机/DLite- History-free Speculative Decoding for Agentic AI/tex/3-DLite.tex
papers.mechanism: History-free hidden-state-conditioned token drafter, with a parallel backbone and sequential lightweight head.
papers.decision: Potentially accelerates reasoning tokens but requires a trained compatible drafter and serving integration.

papers.decision: Useful budgeting principle after measuring available benefit; not justification to resume BERT training now.

implemented.name: SPORK request-local probe draft reuse
implemented.first_launch: Original SPORK first-token timing in the prepared comparison; no BERT
implemented.verification: All proposed tokens go through the existing target rejection sampler; tool commit retains exact name/argument checks.
implemented.scope: Main Actor tool-call body only. Does not implement ETA early exit or accelerate repeated forced probes.

evidence.selection: all valid train prefixes; first now repeat only; confirmed D3 registration at body start

iteration: v1: single vs repeated prefix vs suffix rejoin on recorded greedy tool-call traces
v2: indexed suffix alignment; same decode-step counts on 207 train prefixes
Added request isolation, pending verification, partial rejection, and explicit online mechanism-coverage checks
limitations: Recorded greedy continuation is the verifier oracle; output equality is by construction.
Decode-step counts omit variable GPU verification cost, contention and scheduling.
Only tool-call bodies are replayed; no end-to-end speedup or task-quality claim.
Tokenizer is validated against recorded body IDs, draft lengths and first-block acceptance; no model weights loaded.
760 saved decode steps / 130059 Actor tokens is a scale comparison, not an end-to-end speedup estimate.
Dominant improvement comes from repeated blocks beyond the prototype single-injection cap. Suffix rejoin adds only 28 saved steps beyond prefix mode.
The simulator uses recorded target tokens as the oracle; matching output is by construction, not independent evidence of live equivalence.
